caption: The drawing depicts a wooden armchair viewed directly from the front, centered within a rectangular border on a beige background. The chair is rendered in shades of brown, with defined wood grain visible on its frame. The backrest features a tall, decorative crest rail with a symmetrical cutout heart shape in the center and two rounded finials at the top corners. Below the crest are four vertical slats, evenly spaced. The chair has turned, cylindrical armrests supported by turned vertical posts that extend from the crest rail to the seat. The seat is made of woven material—beige or light tan in color—with a diagonal pattern. The legs and stretchers of the chair are also turned wood, with the stretchers connecting the legs both front to back and side to side. The drawing is detailed and precisely outlined, and a small signature is present at the bottom right corner within the border.
title: Armchair
